findings.description: The KMS key protecting the logs bucket omits enable_key_rotation, which defaults to false, so the same key material is used indefinitely. This extends the blast radius of any key-material compromise and fails common key-management requirements (PCI DSS, CIS AWS 3.8).

deletion_window_in_days is set to the minimum of 7 days. If the key is deleted maliciously or by mistake, there is only a one-week window to cancel deletion, after which all data encrypted under it — including the logs bucket contents that may be needed for incident forensics — becomes permanently unrecoverable. A destructive-availability risk for an attacker with kms:ScheduleKeyDeletion.
